name: Macro-surprise reaction
hypothesis: Enter only after actual release time using a trained response rule for that asset.
spec: Setup: An official economic release differs from a frozen pre-release expectation. Entry: Enter only after actual release time using a trained response rule for that asset. blocked_reason: needs a licensed event feed (earnings surprises, consensus, filings, auction or halt data) with receipt times
